name.full: three.ws 3D Studio: find and generate 3D models

description.short: Find ready-made 3D models and 3D agents, or generate a 3D model from text.
description.full: A declarative agent that searches the free three.ws catalog of ready-made 3D models, searches the public directory of three.ws agents, lists the agents you own, and generates a textured GLB 3D model from a plain-language description. Results open in the three.ws 3D viewer or download as GLB files for PowerPoint, websites and 3D tools.
